newsitem.title: USA: FSA has capacity for two Pa. revenue bond issuers.
newsitem.headline: FSA has capacity for two Pa. revenue bond issuers.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said Monday it has remaining secondary market insurance capacity for the following issues:
--Pennsylvania Convention Center refunding revenue bonds, 1994 series A, dated 6/1/1994.
--Philadelphia Municipal Authority lease revenue refunding bonds, dated 11/1/1993 and 6/15/1993.
Capacity is limited and available first-come, first-served. For more information, call Tom Byrne at 212-826-0601.
